R4 review fixes (2026-10-23) record the dispositions of the independent R4 review. B-1 wires a notify delivery recorder into the app assembly so every send writes its derived notify_deliveries row (a failed derived write stays a WARN: the send already happened, and flipping it to failed would trigger duplicate delivery). H-1 makes the shared-to-exclusive conversion always scan active and archived AGENT.md files for a whole-word resource name, unioning that evidence with the binding projection, so an unrecorded or stale projection can never hide a referrer; a missing workspace root or an unreadable scan fails closed. H-2 keeps a retired credential usable by runs that already pinned it while new admissions fail closed, and the previously asserted 'a credential identity can never recover' wording was narrowed to 'a revoked version can never recover' per the user's credential re-entry ruling. M-1 retires the owned credential identity and its active version inside the same delete transaction (revoked stays revoked; env delete is a no-op). M-2 makes crash recovery release run_resource_refs, run_credential_refs and run_notify_refs exactly like FinishRun, in both the close path and the terminal-run backfill. M-3 computes the affected eligible-agent list once and writes it into both the response and the success operation detail. M-4 records the Windows master-key DACL as a deployment duty (icacls) and corrects the Operations claim that the process verifies permissions there; no new x/sys/windows coordinate is allowed by the zero-dependency rule. L-1 accepts the more conservative run_resource_refs uid backfill (only a live pointer is trusted; deleted pointers stay NULL) and states the deviation in the migration comment. required_tests grew additively only: 012-storage-identity gains TestCredentialStore_ResourceDeleteRetiresCredential plus TestRecovery_ClosesRunningRunsAndReleasesRefs and TestRecovery_BackfillsTerminalRunResidualRefs, and its -run gains TestRecovery_; 012-app-scope gains TestScopeConversion_BlockedByDefinitionScan and TestResourceState_NotifyChannelUsesChannelETagAndImpactHint, and its -run gains TestResourceState_; 012-app-notify-author gains TestNotifyDelivery_ExecutorWritesDerivedRow; 012-credential-managed gains TestCredentialGuard_RetiredKeepsInFlightRunButBlocksAdmission. Test selection only widened; no existing anchor, argv or assertion was removed. Local-only, still not in current.json or CI.
